clause: Batch capabilities: folder-apply, droplet, image-processor, multi-format [STU-AUT-013]

scope.summary: Implement the deduped batch capabilities as ONE runner with options: batch-apply over a folder/set (override-open, suppress-dialogs, destination, filename template, error log); portable batch action (droplet-equivalent re-runnable job artifact processing a passed file set); format-conversion batch (image-processor-equivalent: convert a folder to target formats with resize + profile conversion, with or without a prior macro); multi-format output (one or more formats per source in one pass).
expected_tests: live: folder batch-apply writes results with filename template + error log
test: droplet artifact re-runs on a passed file set
live: image-processor converts folder to 2 formats + resize in one pass

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Batch options: droplets, conversion, multi-format (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Batch capabilities fragment into separate tools; source parity gap.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
